dosm_paddy_yield_1980_2019.csv
Average paddy yield (kg/ha, all seasons) for the ten granary areas combined (DOSM Table 9.2) and for Malaysia (Table 9.1), 1980 to 2019.
Source: Department of Statistics Malaysia (DOSM), 'Padi / Paddy' section; data from the Department of Agriculture Malaysia.
https://dosm.gov.my/admin/images/icon/contentdoc_pdf_20220924205945.pdf   (2018 is provisional, 2019 is an estimate in that document)
Typed in from the published tables: check against the source before quoting. Used only as a transfer-learning SOURCE series
(pipeline/yield_source_transfer.py); it is not mixed into the granary data.

oni_ersstv3b_1980_2015.csv
NOAA Climate Prediction Center, Oceanic Nino Index (3-month running mean of Nino 3.4 SST anomaly), archived ERSST.v3b version, 1980-2015.
https://cpc.ncep.noaa.gov/products/analysis_monitoring/ensostuff/ensoyears_ERSSTv3b.shtml   (typed in from the published table; the current
ONI has moved to a newer ERSST version, so values differ slightly). Used to test whether ENSO explains yield swings (pipeline/yield_covariate_test.py).
